subject: general
question: In which of the following states is the Nrityagram, an Odissi dance institution, located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Nrityagram is an Odissi dance institution located near **Hesaraghatta **Lake in **Karnataka**.
 
• It was established by Odissi dancer Protima Gauri in 1990.
 
• It offers training in 7 Indian classical dance forms.
 
• These are- Odissi, Mohiniattam, Kathak, Bharatnatyam, Kuchipudi, Kathakali, and Manipuri.
 
• It is made by architect Gerard da Cunha.
 
• It is located near Hesaraghatta lake 30km from Bengaluru.
 
• Nrityagram Dance Ensemble has performed across India and in many countries abroad.
 
• Training is offered for a period of 6-7 years to become professional dancers and teachers.
